input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original is redundant because both parts express a time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to people in general, so the plural noun is needed rather than the generic singular noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，Here the mother “sees/notices” the negative effect, so use the result verb rather than the verb meaning “look at.” [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子很小的时候，Introduce the character with a full noun phrase when he first appears, rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和他的妈妈，Use a pronoun for the possessive relationship when the character has just been mentioned; repeating the name in the same phrase is unnecessary. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，This is a repeated habitual action, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友，The relationship is cause and effect, so use the paired connector 因为……所以…… rather than 虽然 with a causal clause. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
人 cannot refer by itself to this concrete general group; 人们 is required.
看到 expresses noticing/seeing the effect, whereas 看了 means looking at it.
孟子 is first introduced here and should first be introduced with a fuller noun phrase.
The repeated 孟子 in 孟子妈妈 is unnecessarily repetitive, and 他的妈妈 correctly links the mother to Mengzi.
老是 marks a habitual action, so sentence-final 了 is not appropriate.
The intended relationship is cause and result, correctly expressed by 因为……所以…….
